newsitem.title: USA: Westpoint buys Britain's P.J. Flower & Co.
newsitem.headline: Westpoint buys Britain's P.J. Flower & Co.

text.p: WestPoint Stevens Inc said Monday its recently formed British subsidiary, WestPoint Stevens (U.K.) Ltd, has acquired P.J. Flower & Co Ltd for an undisclosed sum.

Britain's P.J. Flower manufactures, markets and distributes bed and bath linens and related home furnishings products in Great Britain and Europe. The privately held company reports about $20 million in annual sales, according to WestPoint Stevens.
Westpoint said P.J. Flower is a key supplier in Britain of private-label, solid-color sheet and accessory programs.
The acquisition of P.J. Flower will help launch Westpoint's European business as it pursues its strategic plan, which includes global consumer marketing, the statement said.
